title: Abdominal Ultrasound of Acute Appendicitis
author: James Heilman, MD
caption: Right lower quadrant abdominal ultrasound demonstrating a dilated, non-compressible appendix (>6 mm) with surrounding inflammatory changes.
alt_text: Ultrasound image with caliper markings measuring an enlarged tubular appendix in acute appendicitis.
clinical_relevance: Directly illustrates bedside ultrasound diagnosis of appendicitis, which NASA CliFF-032 notes is >95% sensitive and >97% specific when available in flight (CLIFF-032, p.7).
